blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Responsible preparation begins with what households can do today, while water service remains normal. A strong to very strong El Niño is present in the tropical Pacific and may peak before the end of 2026, according to PAGASA. It may continue through the first half of 2027, increasing the likelihood of below-normal rainfall, dry spells, and drought in parts of the country. This does not mean every household will immediately experience a water service interruption. Conditions will vary by location.
